texts: Sky-cats molt in late summer and early autumn.
Whenever a sky-cat molts, feathers fall to the base of the cliff.
Tessa Brae's collectors gather the fallen feathers each morning during molting weeks.
Ground sky-cat feathers ward lanterns against wraiths.
The Keepers consider sky-cats sacred because sky-cat feathers ward lanterns against wraiths.
The Keepers never harm a sky-cat.
A sky-cat sometimes carries a nightmoth to the spires in flight.

fields.sentence: Sky-cats molt in late summer and early autumn.

q1_issues.issue: Both (Time (sk_molt $x) late_summer) and (Time (sk_molt $x) early_autumn) ride one per-instance Skolem event, asserting a single molting located in two disjoint seasons instead of distributing the coordinated adjunct into two occurrences (or recording a span).

q2_gaps: a non-deictic season expression ('late summer', 'early autumn') as a time value — the Time-term inventory defines only (Year)/(Month)/(Day)/(Weekday)/(Hour)/(Minute) plus deictic and day-part constants, so a bare modified season name has no specified form

a coordinated temporal adjunct ('in A and B') on one clause — the coordination rules cover coordinated clauses and argument NPs, not two same-granularity Time values, and a distributing generic rule has no stated way to mint two per-instance events for one binding
review.notes: The sky_cat compound genus (noun modifier correctly unexposed), the distributing-rule form, Patient for the internal-change intransitive subject and the 0.9/0.9 empirical-generic TVs are all right; only the two-season adjunct is mis-scoped.

issues.reason: The generic-rule machinery of *Quantifiers, generics & scope* mints exactly one Skolem event per binding, so both contiguous seasons can only ride that one event, and each Time atom is true of the sentence under the season-spanning reading that *Multiple live readings* directs the parser to select (a world-knowledge lean, not a tie) — nothing in *Time* bars two same-granularity Time values on one eventuality.

gaps_confirmed: a non-deictic season expression (late summer, early autumn) has no defined Time value — the term inventory is Year/Month/Day/Weekday/Hour/Minute plus deictic and day-part constants only

a coordinated temporal adjunct (in A and B) on one clause: the coordination doctrine distributes coordinated NPs, but a distributing generic rule has no stated way to mint two per-instance events for one binding, so the two routes conflict with no tie-breaker
adjudication.notes: The sky_cat genus with the noun modifier unexposed, Patient for the internal-change intransitive subject, the bare-generic rule with no QuantifierPhrase, and the 0.9/0.9 empirical TVs are all correct. The season symbols are improvisation in genuine gap territory, and every atom emitted there is true and well-typed.

fields.sentence: Whenever a sky-cat molts, feathers fall to the base of the cliff.
parse: (: whenever_molt_fall (Implication (And (Member $c sky_cat) (Member $x molt) (Patient $x $c)) (And (GroupOf (sk_feathers $x) feather) (Member (sk_fall $x) fall) (Patient (sk_fall $x) (sk_feathers $x)) (Goal (sk_fall $x) sk_base_1) (During (sk_fall $x) $x))) (STV 1.0 0.9))

review.notes: Whenever-rule routing, per-occurrence Skolem consequent with the During link, Goal for 'to the base', PartOf for the of-genitive, and the sky_cat compound genus all follow the instruction set; Patient on both the intransitive molt subject and the gravity-moved feathers matches the intransitive-subject tests.

fields.sentence: Tessa Brae's collectors gather the fallen feathers each morning during molting weeks.

q2_gaps: "during" + a bare-plural period noun ("during molting weeks"): the During rule specifies (During <inner> <outer>) with both arguments reified eventualities, and gives no form for a period-denoting NP as the outer argument — the parse uses the bare kind symbol molting_week, which is neither a witness nor a calendar/deictic Time term
review.notes: Group-only encoding of transitive "gather" (no per-member rule) is licensed because the instruction set names gather in its collective-predicate list, though the transitive collecting sense arguably distributes. Everything else — Possession on the possessed group, the distributive (PartOf $x .. -> fallen) rule at 1.0 0.9, Time morning + Every 1 day, and the noun-modifier-suppressed molting_week genus — follows the stated rules.

fields.sentence: Ground sky-cat feathers ward lanterns against wraiths.
parse: (: e415_rule (Implication (And (Member $f sky_cat_feather) (Member $f ground)) (And (Member (sk_ward $f) ward) (Agent (sk_ward $f) $f) (Theme (sk_ward $f) lantern) (Against (sk_ward $f) wraith))) (STV 0.9 0.9))

q1_issues.issue: "sky-cat feather" is fused into the compound kind `sky_cat_feather`, but the modifier is a possessor/whole and the head its part/component (the feather of a sky-cat), which *Compound concepts* explicitly bars from fusing ("car engine", "table leg" -> head kind + `PartOf`).

`(Inheritance sky_cat cat)` decomposes a modifier that the noun-modifier rule says is never exposed, and mints a symbol (`sky_cat`) that appears in no other atom in the parse, leaving a dangling genus disconnected from `sky_cat_feather`.

q2_gaps: the possessor/whole + part/component no-fuse rule is stated only for individual referents ("the car engine" -> witness + `PartOf`); it gives no form for an animal-body-part compound that has to appear as a KIND restriction in a generic rule's premise
review.notes: The routing is right: an adjectivally-restricted kind subject ("ground") forces the distributing-rule route rather than a kind relation, `ground` correctly stays the participial adjective (not `grind`), the inanimate transitive subject takes `Agent`, unchanged "lanterns" takes `Theme` as a bare kind filler, and `Against` is a licensed preposition-named oblique. Only the compound-fusion decision and the dangling `sky_cat` genus are at issue.

issues.reason: Compound concepts bars fusing a possessor/whole + part/component pair — a sky-cat feather is the feather of a sky-cat, exactly the 'car engine' / 'table leg' case, which must emit the head kind plus a PartOf link and never the fused symbol.

(Inheritance sky_cat cat) is the head genus of the hyphenated compound sky_cat, which the compound rule says is always emitted — not the barred exposure of the noun modifier ((Inheritance sky_cat sky)), which the parse correctly omits; its disconnectedness is a symptom of issue 0's fusion, not a false or unlicensed atom.

adjudication.defect_summary: Compliant form: drop the fusion and range the rule over (And (Member $f feather) (Member $f ground) (PartOf $f $c) (Member $c sky_cat)) — head kind plus the part-whole link, the possessor bound by a plain variable — keeping (Inheritance sky_cat cat) and the conclusion bundle unchanged.
adjudication.notes: The reviewer's gap does not stand: the no-fuse form composes inside a rule premise with no improvisation, since a plain variable binds the possessor and PartOf needs no individuated whole. The rest is licensed — the 'ground' participial adjective, the distributing-rule route forced by the restricted kind subject, the bare-kind Theme, and the Against oblique.

fields.sentence: The Keepers consider sky-cats sacred because sky-cat feathers ward lanterns against wraiths.
parse: (: feather_ward_rule (Implication (And (Member $x feather) (Member $y sky_cat) (PartOf $x $y)) (And (Member (sk_ward $x) ward) (Agent (sk_ward $x) $x) (Theme (sk_ward $x) lantern) (Against (sk_ward $x) wraith))) (STV 0.9 0.9))

q2_gaps: active small-clause complement of an attitude verb ("X considers Y ADJ") — the instruction set routes only finite that-clause attitudes and the passive impersonal "is considered to be P", never the active object+predicate small clause

a causal connective whose subordinate clause is a generic that becomes an Implication rule: a rule has no event witness to fill the connective's second endpoint, so the stated "because" link cannot be recorded at all (the nearest guidance, discourse-initial connectives, says never invent an endpoint and record the gap)
review.notes: Name-only handling of the capitalized plural label "the Keepers", the sky_cat genus projecting out of the seal, the PartOf (not fused) reading of "sky-cat feathers", and the Against oblique all follow the instruction set. The causal link is the one thing lost, and it is lost for want of a licensed carrier rather than by mis-parse.

fields.sentence: The Keepers never harm a sky-cat.
parse: (: keepers_harm_neg (And (Member sk_harm_1 harm) (Agent sk_harm_1 keepers) (Patient sk_harm_1 sk_sky_cat_1) (Member sk_sky_cat_1 sky_cat)) (STV 0.0 0.99))

q2_gaps: frequency adverb ('never') on a habitual claim whose subject is a Name-only individual rather than a kind: the mandatory QuantifierPhrase companion is specified as (QuantifierPhrase <kind> <verb-lemma> "<word>") and 'only ever restates a range the rule itself quantifies', but this sentence yields no rule and no quantified range, so the first slot ends up holding an individual constant
review.notes: 'The Keepers' follows the capitalized-plural-label rule (Name-only individual, no GroupOf, no per-member kind), and the strength-0.0 bundle keeping the indefinite 'a sky-cat' witness and its typing inside matches the 'A cooper does not caulk the barrel' pattern.

fields.sentence: A sky-cat sometimes carries a nightmoth to the spires in flight.
parse: (: e1_carry_bundle (And (Member sk_carry_1 carry) (Agent sk_carry_1 sk_sky_cat_1) (Theme sk_carry_1 sk_nightmoth_1) (Goal sk_carry_1 sk_spire_1) (In sk_carry_1 flight)) (STV 0.5 0.9))

q1_issues.issue: The frequency adverb "sometimes" is encoded as strength 0.5 on an (And ...) event bundle, but the instruction set licenses a multi-atom (And ...) container only for negation/cessation, disjunction and sealing, and specifies the frequency dial as setting a rule's or a flat generic's strength, never as a reason to bundle a witness-subject event.

No (QuantifierPhrase sky_cat carry "sometimes") companion is emitted, although the companion is mandatory for every explicit quantifier word the rule or claim consumes, a frequency adverb's word included.

q2_gaps: a frequency adverb ("sometimes") on a verbal clause whose subject is an indefinite singular: the Existential section forces a witness rather than a generic rule, while the frequency dial and its QuantifierPhrase companion are defined only for a rule or a flat generic, so there is no single atom for the 0.5 strength to ride on
review.notes: Compound handling (sky_cat genus cat, solid-spelled nightmoth genus moth, noun modifiers left unexposed), the definite-plural group witness for "the spires", Goal for the non-recipient "to", and the preposition-named (In ... flight) oblique all follow the instruction set.

issues.reason: Gap territory: with an indefinite-singular subject over a verbal predicate the Existential section forces a witness rather than a rule ("a verbal generic takes a bare plural or an explicit quantifier ... not 'a dog'"), so the frequency dial has no rule or flat generic to ride on, while a positive event bundled as one (And ...) fact is a precedented well-typed container (the Disjunction section's "one (And ...) fact ... like a negated event" at STV 1.0 0.99), every conjunct is true of the sentence, and Core patterns bars dropping the hedge instead of carrying it.

The companion "only ever restates a range the rule itself quantifies - never a range that appears nowhere else in the parse", and this parse quantifies over no kind (the subject is the witness sk_sky_cat_1), so (QuantifierPhrase sky_cat carry "sometimes") would invent a kind-level range the parse never states - a coverage gap, not a parse defect.

gaps_confirmed: a frequency adverb on a verbal clause with an indefinite-singular subject: the Existential section forces a witness, while the frequency strength and its QuantifierPhrase companion are defined only over a rule or a flat generic, leaving the adverb no licensed carrier
new_gaps: an indefinite witness posited only by a sub-1.0-strength bundle has no stated projection rule - the "what projects out of a seal" table covers strength-0 denials and attitude seals only, so nothing says whether (Member sk_nightmoth_1 nightmoth) belongs inside the graded bundle or at top level at full strength
adjudication.notes: Compound handling (sky_cat genus cat, solid-spelled nightmoth genus moth, noun modifiers unexposed), the definite-plural group witness, the non-recipient Goal and the (In ... flight) preposition-named oblique are all correct. The one residual worry is the full-strength nightmoth witness sitting outside the 0.5 bundle that is its only source - filed above as a gap rather than as an issue.
